levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «قال حدثني محمد بن الحسن الصفار» is a second man with his own «حدثني» (rule 7), not the same as the first
«رَفَعَهُ إِلَی» is a gap (rule 8): an unnamed link, then Abu Abd Allah as written; he is in the chain, so narrator
«كان علي بن الحسين ع يقول»: the Imam named in the words after the chain is the last link (imam_in_text)
